Located in central Orange County, CA, Canine Rehabilitation of Orange County works to restore quality of life to your geriatric, injured, overweight, postoperative, and neurological or otherwise compromised pet through physical therapy. Our caring team of certified rehabilitation experts will help your dog (or cat) to feel stronger, move better and be safer. Our goals at Canine Rehabilitation of Orange County are to relieve pain, restore range of motion/movement, improve function, prevent injuries and expand the physical potential of each patient we treat.

We created this channel to help our clients see their pups hard at work and to provide educational content when possible.
